id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|29f: The ancient people of Sniflheim reportedly worshipped the beast as the forest's guardian, bringer of rich blessings.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|2ac: ...The beast's name is Moon Baba. After long research, I discovered how the sacred beast Moon Baba came to be.

id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|2c6: Fell Moon Baba absorbs its foe's power to regenerate, so ordinary attacks and spells can never defeat it.

id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|307: It's a book called "The Phantom Kingdom and Magic Items."
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|30d: The ancient Pwachat Kingdom, vanished centuries ago, is thought to have mass-produced magic items.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|320: The last king's chancellor especially pushed magic item development, advancing designs that still apply today.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|332: Among the magic items from his era, the magic doors opened by the Magic key can still be seen around the world today.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|342: But the crucial Magic key vanished just before the kingdom's fall, along with the chancellor who disappeared from it.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|35d: It's a very old book called "Spirits and the World."
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|362: This book... is... the unseen world. This... all... dwelling... faint... showing... spirits...
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|370: ...The book is old and tattered. You can't read any further.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|527: ...The book is old and tattered. You can't read any further.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|5a9: ...The book is old and tattered. You can't read any further.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|388: It's a book called "Wicked Women of Every Age and Place."
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|38e: The Sixth Wicked Woman: the Witch Who Sought Eternal Beauty. Born in a northern kingdom, she was peerless in beauty.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|3a0: She hated all more beautiful than herself and loved only those who praised her. Arrogant, cold, ugly in heart.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|3b1: She dreaded growing old and losing her beauty, and at last turned to forbidden magic.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|3be: Replacing all her blood with glacier ice water, she gained eternal beauty.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|3ca: Since then, her pink skin turned icy blue, and her breath became a curse that freezes everything.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|3d7: It is said 99 poor men were frozen in ice by her kiss, though the truth is uncertain.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|3e3: For not one of the 99 men ever came back from Mirlean Forest, where the witch lives...
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|3fc: It's an old book called "Conquerors of the Northern Sea."
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|401: Yo-heave-ho! When you hear that spirited cry, the Vikings, conquerors of the northern sea, are passing.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|40c: Vikings are armed bands who live by theft and plunder, ravaging coastal towns. Many may picture them so.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|41c: But that is only a minority; most live by trade, and are men proud of their strength.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|42a: When dealing with them, keep smiling, and bring a barrel of liquor as a gift for good relations.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|449: It's an old book called "The Most Terrifying Curse in the World."
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|44f: It began truly suddenly. I hate my own curiosity, for lifting an evil mage's robe in the forest for fun.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|45d: The evil mage whose robe was lifted ran off, saying, "Eek! How embarrassing! I'll curse you!"
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|467: Since then, my own actions are unbearably embarrassing. I must have been cursed by the evil mage.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|471: At church I need the toilet; before women I fret over my hair and can't speak; in battle I recall past blunders...
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|485: I decided to call this most terrifying curse in the world the Curse of Embarrassment.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|48d: Even now I noticed my fly is open. Oh, how embarrassing... how embarrassing...
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|4a1: It's an old book called "The Sealed Dragon."
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|4a6: Long ago, a huge black dragon existed in the frozen north. The Kingdom of Sniflheim was driven into a corner by it.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|4b4: But a young man appeared, defeated the dragon, and sealed it in a lake in Snaerfelt so it could never revive.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|4c2: If the dread dragon revives in an age when that young man is gone, Sniflheim will once again be ruled by terror.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|4db: It's an old book called "The Rings of Yggdrasil."
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|4e2: The rings visible on a stump's cross-section are the very time the tree lived.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|4ea: Then, the biggest tree in the world... how many rings does Yggdrasil have, I wonder.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|4f6: How long has Yggdrasil, who watches over the world, lived watching over Erdrea?
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|503: No, long before Erdrea was born, from an age far beyond our imagining, the great tree may have been alive.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|519: It's a very old book called "The Forbidden Power."
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|51e: Forbidden... the... power. Time... shatter... that... the world... disturb...
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|53d: It's a book called "How a Monster Becomes a God."
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|542: In a certain kingdom, a small town attacked by monsters at every turn was on the brink of ruin.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|54f: Oh, it hurts, it hurts, we can't bear it. Hearing the townsfolk, the town's wisest old man stood up.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|55b: The old man thought: what can I do to save the village? Training soldiers now would be too late.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|567: Walking lost in thought, the old man tripped over a pebble and fell. Then an idea came to him.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|574: Stones are strong. Though small and frail, they are hard enough to trip a man. Would a stone make a strong warrior?
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|583: The old man vowed to make a stone warrior to be the village's guardian, and stood up with a muddy face.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|599: It's a very old book called "Ancient Civilization."
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|59f: Of old... time... gathered... forgotten... far away... lost... civilization...
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|5b4: You defeated Nedra, the Dread Dragon threatening Sniflheim! Report to Queen Charlotte in the castle throne room.
id./param/region/r013.pack|book_ie.bxon|5c9: North: Mirlean Forest. For Zwaardsrust, go through the camp to the south and head east.

tm.何物にもゆるがない 大地のように 防ぐのだ。\nそうすれば 重厚な防御は\nどん: Guard like the earth, unshaken by anything. Then a heavy defense will stop even the mightiest enemy attack.

tm.『森の守り神』という本だ。: It's a book called "The Forest Guardian."
tm.シケスビア雪原にある\n森の奥深くには 巨大な獣が\n生息しているという 言い伝: Legend says a giant beast lives deep in the forest of Snaerfelt.
tm.古代のクレイモランの人々は\n豊かな恵みをもたらす 森の守り神として\nその獣を: The ancient people of Sniflheim reportedly worshipped the beast as the forest's guardian, bringer of rich blessings.
tm.……その獣の名は ムンババ。\n長きにわたる 研究の末 私は 聖獣ムンババが\n: ...The beast's name is Moon Baba. After long research, I discovered how the sacred beast Moon Baba came to be.
tm.意外なことに ムンババは\nもともと 邪神のチカラによって 生まれた\nムンババ: Surprisingly, Moon Baba was originally a monster called Fell Moon Baba, born from the evil god's power.
tm.ムンババ・邪は 相手のチカラを吸収して\n身体を再生するため 通常の攻撃や呪文で: Fell Moon Baba absorbs its foe's power to regenerate, so ordinary attacks and spells can never defeat it.
tm.だが 勇者が使う 雷の呪文\nデイン ライデイン ギガデイン……: But the Luminary's lightning spells: Zap, Zapple, Kazap...
tm.勇者が 仲間と協力して使う\nれんけい技 ミナデインで\nとどめを刺せば そのチ: Say that it yields to their power if finished by the Lightning Storm, the combo the Luminary uses with companions.
tm.そして そのとき ムンババ・邪は\n勇者の聖なるチカラを 吸収し\n聖獣ムンババ: And then Fell Moon Baba absorbs the Luminary's holy power and is reborn as the sacred beast Moon Baba.
tm.『幻の王国と魔法道具』という本だ。: It's a book called "The Phantom Kingdom and Magic Items."
tm.今から数百年前に この世界から姿を消した\n古代プワチャット王国は 魔法道具を量: The ancient Pwachat Kingdom, vanished centuries ago, is thought to have mass-produced magic items.
tm.なかでも 最後の国王に仕えた宰相は\n魔法道具の開発に チカラを入れており\n現: The last king's chancellor especially pushed magic item development, advancing designs that still apply today.
tm.彼の時代に開発された 魔法道具の中でも\n『まほうのカギ』で開く まほうの扉は\: Among the magic items from his era, the magic doors opened by the Magic key can still be seen around the world today.
tm.しかし 肝心の『まほうのカギ』は\nプワチャット王国滅亡の直前に 王国から\n姿: But the crucial Magic key vanished just before the kingdom's fall, along with the chancellor who disappeared from it.
tm.『精霊と世界』という とても古い本だ。: It's a very old book called "Spirits and the World."
tm.本書……は ……見えぬ世界。\nこの…… ありとあらゆる……宿り\nかすかな……: This book... is... the unseen world. This... all... dwelling... faint... showing... spirits...
tm.……本は古く ボロボロだ。\nこれ以上は 読むことができない。: ...The book is old and tattered. You can't read any further.
tm.『古今東西 悪女列伝』という本だ。: It's a book called "Wicked Women of Every Age and Place."
tm.６人目の悪女 ～永遠の美を求めし魔女～\nとある北の王国に生まれた この魔女は\: The Sixth Wicked Woman: the Witch Who Sought Eternal Beauty. Born in a northern kingdom, she was peerless in beauty.
tm.しかし 魔女より 美しいものを憎み\n魔女の美しさを ほめる者だけを愛する。\n: She hated all more beautiful than herself and loved only those who praised her. Arrogant, cold, ugly in heart.
tm.そんな魔女は 自分が老いて\n美しさを失うことを ひどく おそれた。\nそして: She dreaded growing old and losing her beauty, and at last turned to forbidden magic.
tm.身体中の血を 氷河の氷水と入れ替えて\n永遠の美しさを 手に入れたのだ。: Replacing all her blood with glacier ice water, she gained eternal beauty.
tm.それ以来 魔女の桃色の肌は 氷のように青く\n魔女の吐息は すべてを凍らせる 呪: Since then, her pink skin turned icy blue, and her breath became a curse that freezes everything.
tm.これまでに あわれな ９９人の男たちが\n彼女のキスで 氷漬けになったと言われて: It is said 99 poor men were frozen in ice by her kiss, though the truth is uncertain.
tm.なぜなら ９９人の男たちは\n誰ひとりとして 魔女の住む ミルレアンの森から\n: For not one of the 99 men ever came back from Mirlean Forest, where the witch lives...
tm.『北海の覇者』という古い本だ。: It's an old book called "Conquerors of the Northern Sea."
tm.ヤイサホ エイサホー！\n威勢のいい掛け声が 聞こえてきたら\n北海の覇者 バイ: Yo-heave-ho! When you hear that spirited cry, the Vikings, conquerors of the northern sea, are passing.
tm.バイキングとは 盗みや略奪をなりわいとして\n沿岸の町を荒らしまわる 武装集団。: Vikings are armed bands who live by theft and plunder, ravaging coastal towns. Many may picture them so.
tm.しかし それは バイキングの中でも少数で\n彼らの大半は 貿易で生計を立てる\n: But that is only a minority; most live by trade, and are men proud of their strength.
tm.彼らと交流するときは つねに 笑顔を絶やさず\n土産の酒の ひとタルでも 持って: When dealing with them, keep smiling, and bring a barrel of liquor as a gift for good relations.
tm.『世界一 おそろしい呪い』という古い本だ。: It's an old book called "The Most Terrifying Curse in the World."
tm.はじまりは 本当に 突然だった。\n森の中で出会った １匹のエビルマージのローブ: It began truly suddenly. I hate my own curiosity, for lifting an evil mage's robe in the forest for fun.
tm.ローブをめくられた エビルマージは\nきゃー！ はずかしい！ 呪ってやるわっ！\: The evil mage whose robe was lifted ran off, saying, "Eek! How embarrassing! I'll curse you!"
tm.それからというもの おのれの行動が\nはずかしくて はずかしくて たまらない。\: Since then, my own actions are unbearably embarrassing. I must have been cursed by the evil mage.
tm.教会で祈りを捧げようとすると 尿意に襲われ\n女性の前では 髪型が気になって 話: At church I need the toilet; before women I fret over my hair and can't speak; in battle I recall past blunders...
tm.この世界一 おそろしい呪いを\n私は はずかしい呪いと 呼ぶことにした。: I decided to call this most terrifying curse in the world the Curse of Embarrassment.
tm.今も 自分のチャックが\n開いていることに 気がついた。\nああ はずかしい……: Even now I noticed my fly is open. Oh, how embarrassing... how embarrassing...
tm.『封印された竜』という古い本だ。: It's an old book called "The Sealed Dragon."
tm.はるか昔 北の凍てつく大地に\n黒い巨竜が 存在した。\nこの竜に クレイモラン: Long ago, a huge black dragon existed in the frozen north. The Kingdom of Sniflheim was driven into a corner by it.
tm.だが そこへ ひとりの若者が現れ\n巨竜を倒し 二度と復活できぬよう\nシケスビ: But a young man appeared, defeated the dragon, and sealed it in a lake in Snaerfelt so it could never revive.
tm.その若者が いなくなった時代に\n魔竜が復活すれば クレイモラン王国は\nふたた: If the dread dragon revives in an age when that young man is gone, Sniflheim will once again be ruled by terror.
tm.『命の大樹の年輪』という古い本だ。: It's an old book called "The Rings of Yggdrasil."
tm.キリカブの断面に浮かぶ 年輪は\nその木が生きた 時間そのものである。: The rings visible on a stump's cross-section are the very time the tree lived.
tm.では この世界で いちばん大きな木。\n……命の大樹の年輪は\nいったい どのく: Then, the biggest tree in the world... how many rings does Yggdrasil have, I wonder.
tm.世界を見守る 命の大樹は\nいったい どれだけの長い時を生き\nロトゼタシアを: How long has Yggdrasil, who watches over the world, lived watching over Erdrea?
tm.いや ロトゼタシアが生まれる ずっと前。\n我らの想像など はるか及ばぬ昔から\: No, long before Erdrea was born, from an age far beyond our imagining, the great tree may have been alive.
tm.『禁じられしチカラ』という とても古い本だ。: It's a very old book called "The Forbidden Power."
tm.禁じられし……る ……チカラ。\n時の……砕き ……ことは\n世界の…… 乱し…: Forbidden... the... power. Time... shatter... that... the world... disturb...
tm.『いかにして魔物は神となるか』という本だ。: It's a book called "How a Monster Becomes a God."
tm.とある世界の とある王国に\nことあるごとに 魔物に襲われて\n壊滅寸前の 小さ: In a certain kingdom, a small town attacked by monsters at every turn was on the brink of ruin.
tm.ああ 苦しい 苦しい たえられない。\nそんな町民の声を聞き 立ちあがった\n町: Oh, it hurts, it hurts, we can't bear it. Hearing the townsfolk, the town's wisest old man stood up.
tm.おじいさんは 思いました。\n村の危機を救うため できることはなんだろう\n今か: The old man thought: what can I do to save the village? Training soldiers now would be too late.
tm.うわの空で歩いていた おじいさんは\n足元にある 小石にけつまずいて 転びました: Walking lost in thought, the old man tripped over a pebble and fell. Then an idea came to him.
tm.石は強い こんなに小さく はかなげでも\n人を転ばせるほど かたくて 強い。\n: Stones are strong. Though small and frail, they are hard enough to trip a man. Would a stone make a strong warrior?
tm.おじいさんは 村の守り神となる\n石の戦士を作ると 心に誓い\n泥のついたカオで: The old man vowed to make a stone warrior to be the village's guardian, and stood up with a muddy face.
tm.『古代の文明』という とても古い本だ。: It's a very old book called "Ancient Civilization."
tm.いにしえの…… 時……集いし\n忘却の…… はるかなる……\n失われし……の 文: Of old... time... gathered... forgotten... far away... lost... civilization...
tm.クレイモラン地方の 平和をおびやかす魔物\n魔竜ネドラを倒した！ クレイモラン城: You defeated Nedra, the Dread Dragon threatening Sniflheim! Report to Queen Charlotte in the castle throne room.
tm.ここより北 ミルレアンの森\nゼーランダ山に お越しの方は\n南のキャンプを抜け: North: Mirlean Forest. For Zwaardsrust, go through the camp to the south and head east.
